title: 50th Anniversary of the World Food Programme

obverse.description: A globe bearing the World Food Programme inscription, accompanied by ears of wheat, maize, and rice. The design also includes the Italian Republic monogram, the Rome mint mark, and the year 2004.

title: 75th Anniversary of the Founding of Vatican City State

obverse.description: A schematic view of the Vatican City walls and St Peter's Basilica, surrounded by anniversary dates and inscriptions marking 75 years since the state's founding.
obverse.imageKey: Vatican City/John Paul II (Ioannes Paulus II) (1978-2005)/2004/John Paul II State anniversary - Obverse.jpg

reverse.imageKey: Vatican City/John Paul II (Ioannes Paulus II) (1978-2005)/2004/John Paul II State anniversary - Reverse.jpg

title: Bartolomeo Borghesi

obverse.description: A bust of historian and numismatist Bartolomeo Borghesi, encircled by the twelve stars of the European Union, his name, San Marino, and the year 2004.

title: Effigy and Monogram of Grand Duke Henri

obverse.description: Grand Duke Henri's right-facing portrait appears beside his crowned monogram. The surrounding inscriptions include Luxembourg's name, his title, the year 2004, mint marks, and twelve stars.

title: Enlargement of the European Union by Ten New Member States

obverse.description: A stylised pillar supports upward-growing shoots, symbolising the European Union's enlargement and its foundation for growth. The design includes the letters EU, the year 2004, and twelve stars.
obverse.imageKey: Finland/Republic (1919-date)/2004/Enlargement of the European Union - Obverse.jpg

reverse.imageKey: Finland/Republic (1919-date)/2004/Enlargement of the European Union - Reverse.jpg

title: Olympic Games in Athens 2004

obverse.description: An ancient statue of a discobolus preparing to throw the discus, accompanied by the Athens 2004 Olympic emblem, the Greek euro denomination, the yearmark, and twelve stars.

title: 20th World Youth Day

obverse.description: Cologne Cathedral with a comet passing overhead, surrounded by the World Youth Day inscription, the year 2005, the Rome mint mark, Vatican City's name, and twelve stars.

title: World Year of Physics 2005

obverse.description: A free interpretation of an allegorical painting of Galileo Galilei studying the planets, with a globe, a stylised atom, the year 2005, San Marino's name, the Rome mint mark, and twelve stars.

title: 1st Anniversary of the Signing of the European Constitution

obverse.description: Europa riding the bull while holding a pen and the text of the European Constitution, accompanied by the Italian Republic monogram, the Rome mint mark, the year 2005, and twelve stars.

title: 60th Anniversary of the United Nations and 50th Anniversary of Finland's Membership

obverse.description: Jigsaw puzzle pieces form a dove of peace above the inscription FINLAND — UN, accompanied by the year 2005, the engraver's initial, the mint mark, and twelve stars.

title: 50th Anniversary of the Austrian State Treaty

obverse.description: The signatures and seals from the Austrian State Treaty appear over vertical stripes representing Austria's national colours, together with an anniversary inscription, the year 2005, and twelve stars.

title: 400th Anniversary of the First Edition of Don Quixote

obverse.description: Don Quixote holding a lance with windmills in the background, accompanied by Spain's name, the Madrid mint mark, the year 2005, and twelve stars.

title: Belgium–Luxembourg Economic Union

obverse.description: The profiles of Grand Duke Henri of Luxembourg and King Albert II of Belgium above the year 2005, surrounded by their monograms, mint marks, and twelve stars.

title: Anniversaries of Grand Dukes Henri and Adolphe

obverse.description: Grand Duke Henri's right-facing portrait superimposed on that of Grand Duke Adolphe, with their names and commemorative dates, Luxembourg's name, the year 2005, mint marks, and twelve stars.

title: 5th Centenary of the Swiss Pontifical Guard

obverse.description: A Swiss guard taking an oath of loyalty to the Pope, surrounded by the Swiss Pontifical Guard inscription, the dates 1506 and 2006, Vatican City's name, the Rome mint mark, and twelve stars.

title: 500th Anniversary of Christopher Columbus' Death

obverse.description: Christopher Columbus with three caravels, a wind rose, the Rome mint mark, San Marino's name, and the dates 1506–2006 on a scroll, surrounded by twelve stars.

title: 100th Anniversary of Universal and Equal Suffrage

obverse.description: Male and female faces separated by a line, flanked by the date 1 October 1906 and the inscription 20 FI 06, with mint marks beside the faces and twelve stars around the design.

title: Atomium

obverse.description: The Atomium monument with the engraver's initials and two mint marks, surrounded by the letter B, the year 2006, and twelve stars.

title: Schleswig-Holstein

obverse.description: Lübeck's Holstentor gate above the name Schleswig-Holstein, accompanied by the engraver's initials, one of five German mint marks, the year 2006, Germany's official name, and twelve stars.

title: XX Olympic Winter Games — Turin 2006

obverse.description: A skier in motion beside Turin's Mole Antonelliana, accompanied by the Winter Games inscription, the Italian Republic monogram, the Rome mint mark, the year 2006, and twelve stars.

title: 25th Birthday of Grand Duke Guillaume

obverse.description: Grand Duke Henri's portrait superimposed on that of Hereditary Grand Duke Guillaume, with Luxembourg's name, the year 2006, mint marks, and twelve stars.
